name: Typical Cats
description: '''Typical Cats''' is an American [[underground hip hop]] [[Musical ensemble|group]] from [[Chicago, Illinois]]. The group consists of [[rapping|MCs]] [[Denizen Kane]], [[Qwazaar]] and [[Qwel]], and [[hip hop production|producers]] / [[disc jockey|DJs]] Kid Knish and DJ Natural. They have released three albums to date. Their song "Any Day" from their [[Typical Cats (album)|self-titled debut]] was featured in the video game ''[[Tony Hawk's Project 8]]''.
